purpose: Pre-race candidate features and separate post-race labels for learning which L1 expert and TopN should populate each betting formation column.
granularity: one race x column x expert x top_n candidate

columns.COL1: candidate set intended for first-position/axis responsibility
columns.COL2: candidate set intended for second-position/mainline responsibility
columns.COL3: candidate set intended for third-position/opponent responsibility

principles: Candidate size is an explicit cost; larger TopN must not be treated as automatically better.
Models estimate slot-capture probability; downstream optimization trades capture probability against ticket-size cost.
COL1/COL2/COL3 are learned separately or with column identity explicitly represented.
Dead heats create multiple valid ordered podium outcomes and must not be treated as missing truth.
